E2 provides wear data for the coating but does not link wear performance to oxide formation or high-temperature conditions, leaving the self-healing mechanism and pre-treatment effect unsupported by cited evidence.
premises: Thermal exposure of FeNiCrCoCu coating in air forms a protective Cr2O3-based oxide layer
This oxide layer enhances wear resistance
The oxide layer acts as a self-healing barrier reducing metal contact and oxidation
